authority: A1 adjudicates freeze ambiguities; lanes never improve the spec silently

A4_Q1_no_older_quote_resurrection.reason: resurrecting an older quote after the latest goes stale would hide staleness, violating observable fail-closed behavior (plan section 6.4/7.3); a stale venue-local is skipped and counted

A4_Q2_consolidation_reference_currency.reason: deterministic, order-independent reference-currency rule accepted (currency of fresh venue-local with lexicographically smallest venue name; None pairs only with None)
A4_Q2_consolidation_reference_currency.correction: A1 integration correction: the consolidated result must RECORD the chosen reference currency (add to the result dict) so currency exclusion is observable, not silent

A4_Q3_tca_asof_boundaries.reason: as-of window [t-threshold, t] inclusive on both bounds is the natural known-at-decision-time semantics; boundary equality counts fresh

A4_Q4_total_cost_components.reason: total_cost_view sums decision-to-fill slippage + fees + funding only; effective/realized spread and impact are diagnostic decompositions and summing them would double-count

A4_Q5_views_ignore_rejected.reason: INVALID/QUARANTINED events may never re-enter accepted views (fail-closed hygiene)
